course.title: Electrical Drives and Instrumentation

content.value: A meter has an internal resistance of 100 ohm and requires 1 mA for full scale deflection. It is to be converted to a 10 V ac voltmeter using circuit shown ion Fig. 2. The shunt resistor placed across the meter has a value of 100 ohm. Rectifiers D1 & D2 each have a forward resistance of 400 ohm and are assumed to have infinite resistance in reverse direction. Calculate i) value of multiplier Rs and ii) voltmeter sensitivity.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
